description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's rebase functionality with internationalization (i18n) encoding changes. It includes setup steps, test cases for rebasing with encoding conversions, and helper functions for verifying commit message encodings.

methods.name: compare_msg
methods.description: Compares the encoded message file with the corresponding commit message in the current HEAD after converting file encoding.

methods.name: test_rebase_continue_update_encode
methods.description: Performs a rebase continuation step after changing commit encodings, testing encoding conversion handling.
